q: В каком месяце 2024 года было больше всего сделок?
sql: SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE year = 2024 GROUP BY month ORDER BY deals DESC LIMIT 1

q: Qaysi yilda eng ko'p paxta sotilgan?
sql: SELECT year, unit, SUM(volume) AS total_volume FROM deals WHERE tnved = '520100' AND is_cancelled = 0 GROUP BY year, unit ORDER BY total_volume DESC LIMIT 1

q: Сколько сделок по цементу было в 2024 году по сравнению с 2023?
sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE tnved = '252329' AND year IN (2023, 2024) GROUP BY year

q: 2025-yilda bug'doyning eng past va eng yuqori narxi qancha bo'lgan?
sql: SELECT unit, currency, MIN(unit_price) AS min_price, MAX(unit_price) AS max_price, COUNT(*) AS deals FROM deals WHERE tnved = '100199' AND year = 2025 AND is_cancelled = 0 GROUP BY unit, currency

q: Первая и последняя сделка компании с ИНН 921973071?
sql: SELECT p.inn, p.name, (SELECT deal_no FROM deals WHERE seller_inn = p.inn OR buyer_inn = p.inn ORDER BY deal_date, deal_time LIMIT 1) AS first_deal, MIN(d.deal_date) AS first_date, (SELECT deal_no FROM deals WHERE seller_inn = p.inn OR buyer_inn = p.inn ORDER BY deal_date DESC, deal_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_deal, MAX(d.deal_date) AS last_date FROM participants p JOIN deals d ON d.seller_inn = p.inn OR d.buyer_inn = p.inn WHERE p.inn = '921973071' GROUP BY p.inn

q: Ma'lumotlardagi eng oxirgi bitim qaysi?
sql: SELECT deal_no, deal_date, deal_time, product, volume, unit, amount, currency, status FROM deals ORDER BY deal_date DESC, deal_time DESC LIMIT 1

q: Когда был зарегистрирован самый старый контракт и сколько контрактов зарегистрировано в тот день?
sql: SELECT MIN(reg_date) AS first_reg_date, COUNT(*) AS contracts_that_day FROM contracts WHERE reg_date = (SELECT MIN(reg_date) FROM contracts)

q: 2025-yilda nechta xil tovar sotilgan?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tnved) AS products FROM deals WHERE year = 2025 AND is_cancelled = 0

q: Сколько компаний из Андижанской области являются продавцами?

q: Paxta xaridorlari orasida nechtasi QQS to'lovchi?
